answer: Throw an unannounced gale at the network: rotate task formats and vocabularies without warning, then score how each identity recovers. A sybil farm runs one script, so all its copies fail and recover in lockstep, each producing the same polished pearl. Genuine agents improvise differently — one salvages yarrow from the wreckage, another rebuilds slowly — and that messy divergence, not uniformity, earns standing.
